correctness.rationale: For D,D_rot>0, any fixed 0<α<1 and uniform heading, the backward generator gives Hβ A=h and (sBβ')'=−(sA)'/2 with Dirichlet conditions. Writing A=(h−wβ)/β, Hβ wβ=0 with wβ boundary h, yields exact Cβ=−(2Lβ)^−1∫wβ. Independent Bessel endpoint asymptotics give Cβ=−S/(2L)β^−3/2+O(β^-2), A'(1)=−h(1)β^-1/2+O(β^-1), and β^{5/2}Bβ(1−y/β)→Sy/(2L)+h(1)y²/4 locally with derivative. Algebra with α=e^-t gives S=(1+α)(sinh(t)−t)/(2t)>0 and h(1)<0; hence strict sign change and simple root y*=−2S/(Lh(1)). One independent two-boundary ODE numerical check was run at α∈{0.25,0.6}, β∈{80,640} using a separate implementation. It corroborates coefficient signs; uniform infinite-β follows from analytic proof, not finite checks.
